tracker.description: The tracker's own vocabulary. Read it with /acceptance-workflow or the tracker_vocabulary tool.

active.description: State of a ticket or sub-task being worked (YouTrack: In Progress, Azure DevOps: Active).

closed.description: State of a finished sub-task (Done, Closed).

done.description: State the ticket ends in: one name, or one per ticket type, "*" for the others.

link.description: YouTrack only: the command that links a sub-task to its ticket.

fields.description: Field names (YouTrack) or reference names (Azure DevOps). Left out: the tracker's defaults.

spent.description: Azure DevOps only. Default: Microsoft.VSTS.Scheduling.CompletedWork. YouTrack logs work items.

billable.description: A separate field for billable time, written when time.billable is true.

modules.description: Module name → globs of the paths that belong to it. An edited file is attributed to the first module that matches.

requires.description: Step ids that must be done first; "<id>:all" for a per-subtask step done on every sub-task.

repeat.description: The step runs once per sub-task, named by its module.

gates.description: What the plugin refuses until a step is done.

edit.description: Editing code. A per-subtask step means: the edited file's module has an open sub-task with that step done.

pullRequest.description: gh pr create and the GitHub MCP create_pull_request.

round.description: Measured time is rounded up to this many minutes.

billable.description: Also write max(real time, estimate) to tracker.fields.billable. The real time is always what is logged as time spent.
